Description:
[center]
[size=6][b][color=#42BDF2]BENTLEYPLAYZ[/color] [color=#FFD45C]ADVERTISING[/color][/b][/size]

[size=4][color=#FFFFFF]THE ADVERTISING EXPERIENCE FOR STARDEW VALLEY[/color][/size]

[color=#A9B7C6]Developed by BentleyPlayz[/color]

[size=5][b][color=#FFD45C]EVER WISHED YOUR VALLEY HAD ITS OWN ADVERTISING INDUSTRY?[/color][/b][/size]

[size=3][color=#FFFFFF]Well, now it does.[/color][/size]

Discover a new way to experience Stardew Valley with BentleyPlayz Advertising — a custom advertising system featuring businesses around the valley, promotional messages, advertiser letters, subscription offers, and integrated developer tools.

[line]

[size=6][b][color=#42BDF2]WHAT IS BENTLEYPLAYZ ADVERTISING?[/color][/b][/size]
[/center]

BentleyPlayz Advertising is a custom-built advertising framework that brings an advertising industry into Stardew Valley.

Businesses operating around the valley can promote their products and services through the advertising system.

Players encounter these advertisements through two channels: promotional letters delivered to their mailbox and automatic in-game advertising popups displayed every 5 minutes.

The system also includes subscription offers, a dedicated advertising interface, and integrated developer tools.

This is not simply a collection of signs or static advertisements. It is an integrated system with its own advertising content, menus, and supporting functionality.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#FFD45C]01 — THE ADVERTISING SYSTEM[/color][/b][/size]

[color=#42BDF2][b]ADVERTISEMENTS FROM BUSINESSES AROUND THE VALLEY[/b][/color]

Discover businesses operating throughout the Stardew Valley world through BentleyPlayz Advertising.

Businesses promote their products, services, and offers through two advertising channels: promotional letters delivered to the player's mailbox and automatic in-game advertising popups displayed every 5 minutes.

The release includes:

[list]
[*]11 businesses with their own promotional identities.
[*]22 advertising letters containing promotional content.
[*]Advertiser mail delivered through the in-game mailbox.
[*]Automatic advertising popups every 5 minutes.
[*]Advertiser-specific promotional messages.
[*]A dedicated advertising interface.
[/list]
Whether delivered through the mailbox or displayed during gameplay, each advertisement gives businesses around the valley an opportunity to reach the player.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#FFD45C]02 — ADVERTISER MAIL[/color][/b][/size]

[color=#42BDF2][b]PROMOTIONS DELIVERED TO YOUR MAILBOX[/b][/color]

Advertising does not stop at popup messages.

The system also includes 22 advertiser letters that deliver promotional content through Stardew Valley's mailbox.

These letters give businesses another way to introduce themselves, communicate promotions, and reach the player during gameplay.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#FFD45C]03 — SUBSCRIPTION OFFERS[/color][/b][/size]

[color=#42BDF2][b]EXPLORE THE AVAILABLE OFFERS[/b][/color]

BentleyPlayz Advertising includes an in-game subscription offer system.

Players can open the advertising interface and explore the available offers.

The release includes 9 subscription offers, providing different options within the advertising system.

The system also tracks ad-free subscription time, allowing the developer tools to clear that time when testing is necessary.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#FFD45C]04 — INTEGRATED DEVELOPER TOOLS[/color][/b][/size]

[color=#C58AFF][b]DEVELOPMENT AND TESTING BUILT INTO THE MOD[/b][/color]

This release combines BentleyPlayz Advertising and its Developer Tools into one integrated mod.

Developer functionality is intended to help with testing the advertising system without having to wait for normal gameplay events.

Developer tools include:

[list]
[*]Developer Menu: Access the integrated developer interface.
[*]Force Advertisements: Trigger advertising messages for testing.
[*]Force Advertiser Letters: Test advertiser mail functionality.
[*]Subscription Testing: Clear existing ad-free subscription time.
[/list]
Developer mode is disabled by default.

The developer menu can be accessed using the available developer controls when developer mode is enabled.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#FFD45C]05 — CONFIGURATION[/color][/b][/size]

BentleyPlayz Advertising includes configuration support for its developer functionality.

The developer-mode setting allows players to control whether the integrated developer tools are enabled.

For ordinary gameplay, developer mode can remain disabled.

[line]

[size=6][b][color=#42BDF2]INSTALLATION GUIDE[/color][/b][/size]

Follow these instructions to install BentleyPlayz Advertising.

[size=4][b][color=#FFD45C]STEP 1 — INSTALL SMAPI[/color][/b][/size]

Make sure SMAPI is installed and working with your Stardew Valley installation.

[size=4][b][color=#FFD45C]STEP 2 — DOWNLOAD THE MOD[/color][/b][/size]

Download the BentleyPlayz Advertising archive from the Files section of this Nexus Mods page.

[size=4][b][color=#FFD45C]STEP 3 — EXTRACT THE ARCHIVE[/color][/b][/size]

Extract the downloaded ZIP archive.

[size=4][b][color=#FFD45C]STEP 4 — INSTALL THE MOD FOLDER[/color][/b][/size]

Place the extracted mod folder into your Stardew Valley Mods directory.

Your folder structure should look similar to this:

[code]
Stardew Valley/
└── Mods/
└── BentleyPlayz.Advertising/
├── manifest.json
├── BentleyPlayz.Advertising.dll
└── advertisements.json
[/code]
[size=4][b][color=#FFD45C]STEP 5 — LAUNCH THE GAME[/color][/b][/size]

Start Stardew Valley through SMAPI.

Check the SMAPI console to confirm that BentleyPlayz Advertising has loaded successfully.

[line]
